name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in enterprise IT. Frustrated with the corporate grind, she leveraged her extensive experience in network infrastructure and data security to carve out a niche in the fast-paced world of racing. Initially volunteering at local rallies to hone her skills in challenging environments, she quickly impressed teams with her ability to troubleshoot complex IT issues under pressure.

At Boutsen VDS, Milena is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of all IT systems, from the telemetry data analysis tools used by engineers to the communication infrastructure that connects the team during races. She takes a proactive approach, constantly seeking ways to improve the team's technological capabilities and safeguard sensitive information. Her meticulous nature and dedication to problem-solving make her an invaluable asset, providing a stable and secure foundation for the team's performance on the track. 

What sets Milena apart is her ability to bridge the gap between the technical and the human aspects of motorsport. She understands that technology is only as good as the people who use it, and she's passionate about empowering her colleagues with the tools and knowledge they need to succeed.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a practical low ponytail
physical.description: Milena has a focused look, accentuated by her stylish glasses and confident posture.

Insists on backing up all data to physical drives in addition to cloud storage.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating.
